verdict.rationale: Mixpanel documents a dedicated Retention report for assessing user engagement over a specified period of time. It also documents cohort creation and cohort retrieval via the Query API, and retention can be queried through its MCP server. That covers the core of measuring retention over time, but the evidence never explicitly shows retention being segmented by behavioral (event-based) cohorts; cohorts are described only as built from properties. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of breaking down or filtering retention by behavioral cohorts, and independent or hands-on corroboration of retention analysis.
